steps: Join the common center to the touching point and to either endpoint of the segment.
A radius is perpendicular to a tangent. The perpendicular from a circle's center bisects a chord, so half the segment is 7 cm.
If the radii are R and r, Pythagoras gives R² = r² + 7², hence R² − r² = 49.
Ring area = πR² − πr² = π(R² − r²) = 49π cm². Neither radius is needed separately.
